title: Fusion Pay
tagline: Connect fiat & crypto effortlessly! Seamless on/off-ramp with low fees & top security
description:
The current on/off-ramp landscape is fragmented and inefficient. Users face high, non-transparent fees, confusing interfaces, and the constant threat of network attacks like MEV (Miner Extractable Value), which can silently eat away at their gains. This friction creates a significant barrier to entry for newcomers and a constant headache for experienced users.

Our Solution
Fusion Pay bridges this gap by leveraging the most advanced technology in decentralized finance. We integrate 1inch's Fusion mode and aggregate leading fiat payment providers to deliver a superior on/off-ramp experience.
how_its_made:
High-Level Architecture
Fusion Pay is built on a hybrid architecture, combining a modern, responsive frontend with a robust backend that acts as the intelligent bridge between fiat payment APIs and the DeFi world via the 1inch Fusion protocol.

Frontend: The user-facing application where the on/off-ramp journey begins.

Backend: The core "Fusion Engine" that handles all the complex logic, API integrations, and smart routing.

Integrations: The crucial external services we connected, including 1inch and a third-party fiat provider.
